<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Untamed Form](/Feats.aspx?ID=4713) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 128

**Prerequisites**
[untamed order](/DruidicOrders.aspx?ID=4)

</column>

---

You are one with the wild, always changing and adapting to meet any challenge. You gain the [_untamed form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1861) order spell, which lets you transform into a variety of shapes that you can expand with druid feats.

<title level="2">Untamed Form leads to...</title>
[Anthropomorphic Shape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4720), [Elemental Shape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4741), [Ferocious Shape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4734), [Form Control](/Feats.aspx?ID=4723), [Insect Shape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4730), [Monstrosity Shape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4760), [Plant Shape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4744), [Reactive Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=4754), [Soaring Shape](/Feats.aspx?ID=4739), [Too Much to Swallow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5408), [True Shapeshifter](/Feats.aspx?ID=4767)
name: Untamed Form
